description: SPORTY, STYLISH, FUN-TO-DRIVE, LOW-MILEAGE, ONE-OWNER, OFF-LEASE, NONSMOKER, THE HATCHBACK THAT DOES IT ALL! Few nameplates have earned the loyalty of drivers the way the Honda Civic has, and the Civic Hatchback brings that reputation together with a sportier look and a far more flexible cargo area. This 2024 Honda Civic Hatchback Sport Touring, finished in Crystal Black Pearl and showing just over 18,700 miles, is the top of the hatchback lineup, packed with the comfort and technology features that make an everyday commute feel like a treat. Crystal Black Pearl is a deep, glossy black with a subtle pearl shimmer that gives the Civic's sculpted lines a sharp, upscale look. Add a one-owner, off-lease history, regular oil changes on CARFAX, and factory coverage that still has time and miles remaining, and this Civic makes an easy case for itself. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Civic Hatchback occupies a sweet spot that few vehicles can match. It drives with the agility and efficiency of a compact car, yet the hatchback body opens up 24.5 cubic feet of cargo space, enough for four full-size suitcases with room to spare, and the rear seats fold down when you need even more room. Reviewers have called it an affordable intersection of form, function, and fun, a description that fits the way it blends practicality with a genuine sense of enjoyment behind the wheel. Honda's reputation adds to the appeal. The Civic is known for thoughtful engineering, a comfortable and well-organized cabin, and a broad dealer network that makes ownership simple. For shoppers who want a stylish, efficient hatchback without giving up features, the Sport Touring is the trim that delivers the most. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Capital One's review of the 2024 Civic Hatchback praised its turbocharged engine and its spirited yet refined acceleration. The reviewer noted that the Sport Touring model excels on winding roads, with impressive grip and predictable behavior that builds driver confidence, and highlighted the balance Honda strikes between ride comfort and body control. The review also praised the cabin's quality materials and intuitive controls, along with the hatchback's generous cargo space. Reviewers do note that highway noise can be noticeable and that the Civic Hatchback is not offered with all-wheel drive, which are common trade-offs in this class. For most shoppers, they are small compromises for a hatchback that is this engaging to drive. Warranty With 18,724 miles on the odometer and CARFAX showing regular oil changes, this Civic is STILL COVERED by the remainder of Honda's factory protection, which transfers to the next retail owner. Remaining transferable factory coverage: New Vehicle Limited Warranty: 3 years or 36,000 miles, whichever comes first. Based on the June 24, 2024 warranty start date, this coverage runs through June 24, 2027, with roughly 17,200 miles of allowance remaining. Powertrain Limited Warranty: 5 years or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first, covering the engine, transmission, and drivetrain components. This coverage runs through June 24, 2029, with roughly 41,200 miles of allowance remaining. For buyers who want protection beyond the remaining factory coverage, extended service plans are available for purchase. Standard Features The Sport Touring is the top of the Civic Hatchback lineup, and it is loaded with the touches that make everyday driving more enjoyable. Leather-trimmed seating, heated front seats, and an eight-way power driver's seat make the cabin feel a class above, while dual-zone automatic climate control lets the driver and front passenger each choose their own temperature. A 12-speaker Bose premium audio system, a 9-inch touchscreen with built-in navigation, and wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto round out the package, giving the Sport Touring the kind of technology that is usually reserved for more expensive vehicles. Mechanical Features Power comes from Honda's 1.5-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine, which produces 180 horsepower and 177 lb-ft of torque. Turbocharging delivers its torque low in the rev range, so the Civic feels quick and lively around town and has confident passing power on the highway, and it does so with impressive efficiency. The EPA rates the Civic Hatchback Sport Touring at 30 mpg city, 38 mpg highway, and 33 mpg combined. A continuously variable transmission keeps the engine in its most efficient range and delivers smooth, seamless acceleration, and the Civic's balanced chassis and well-tuned suspension are what give it the grip and predictable handling reviewers praise. It is a compact hatchback that rewards a spirited drive on a twisty road while remaining calm and composed on a daily commute. Exterior Features Crystal Black Pearl is a deep, rich black with a fine pearl flake that catches the light and shows off the Civic Hatchback's sculpted lines. It gives this Civic a sophisticated, sporty presence that looks just as good in the office parking lot as it does on a weekend drive. The hatchback body gives the Civic a sleek, athletic profile, and the Sport Touring rides on 18-inch alloy wheels that fill the wheel arches and give the car a planted, confident stance. LED lighting and a clean, modern design complete the look. Interior Features Inside, the Civic Hatchback feels more premium than its class might suggest. Leather-trimmed seats, heated front seats, and an eight-way power driver's seat help the driver find a comfortable position for long drives, and dual-zone automatic climate control keeps everyone comfortable in every season. Practicality is where the hatchback shines. The cargo area offers 24.5 cubic feet of space, enough for four full-size suitcases, and the folding rear seats let you expand that space when you need to carry bikes, furniture, or gear, making the Civic a truly flexible everyday companion. Infotainment & Technology The Sport Touring's 9-inch touchscreen puts navigation, music, and phone functions right at your fingertips, with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto so your phone connects without a cable the moment you get in. The interface is clean and intuitive, with large icons that make it easy to use on the go. A 12-speaker Bose premium audio system fills the cabin with rich, detailed sound, turning every commute or road trip into a concert of your own choosing. Safety Features Honda Sensing is standard, bringing a suite of driver-assistance technologies to every Civic. Collision Mitigation Braking helps detect a potential frontal collision and applies the brakes if the driver does not respond in time, Adaptive Cruise Control eases the strain of highway commuting, and Lane Keeping Assist and Road Departure Mitigation help keep the vehicle on its intended path. Blind Spot Information gives additional confidence when changing lanes, and a rearview camera with dynamic guidelines makes backing into tight spaces easier. Together with a comprehensive airbag system, these features give drivers extra peace of mind on every trip. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line This Civic Hatchback delivers the things compact shoppers love most: a peppy turbocharged engine, impressive fuel economy, a roomy and flexible hatchback cabin, and the premium touches of the Sport Touring trim, including leather-trimmed heated seats, navigation, and a 12-speaker Bose audio system. With low mileage, a one-owner, off-lease history, regular oil changes on CARFAX, and factory coverage still in place, it is a smart, easy-to-love way to enjoy a hatchback with real personality. This Civic is ready to turn every commute into something you look forward to.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Technology and Telematics

description: INNOVATIVE, ECO-SMART, ONE-OWNER, OFF-LEASE, NONSMOKER, EFFICIENCY REDEFINED! The 2024 Toyota Prius Prime arrives having already claimed one of the biggest honors in the industry, and it earns every bit of the attention. This SE grade is the ideal entry point into Toyota's fully redesigned Prius Prime lineup, combining genuine plug-in flexibility with the low-maintenance dependability the Prius name has built its reputation on for more than two decades. Finished in Midnight Black Metallic, this one-owner, off-lease example comes backed by a documented history of regular oil changes, giving the next owner real confidence in how it was cared for. Why Shoppers Buy This Model Few nameplates have done more to change how people think about efficient driving than the Prius. Since its debut, Toyota has used the Prius as a proving ground for its hybrid technology, and that engineering pedigree shows up in exceptional real-world fuel economy, a reputation for going hundreds of thousands of miles with only routine maintenance, and resale value that consistently outperforms the rest of the compact-car segment. The Prius Prime takes that formula further by adding a plug. Shoppers who want the flexibility to drive most short trips and commutes on electricity alone, while still having a gas engine ready for road trips with no range anxiety and no need to hunt for a charging station, consistently choose the Prime over a full battery-electric vehicle for exactly this reason. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The completely redesigned fifth-generation Prius lineup didn't just turn heads with its styling -- it swept the industry's most respected honors. Independent reviewers have praised its dramatically improved driving dynamics, sharper handling, and genuinely quick real-world acceleration, a first for a nameplate once known mainly for its efficiency rather than its personality. 2024 MOTORTREND CAR OF THE YEAR 2024 NORTH AMERICAN CAR OF THE YEAR CAR AND DRIVER 10BEST (2024) GREEN CAR JOURNAL 2024 BEST OVERALL GREEN CAR Warranty With just 28,584 miles on the odometer and still well within its original coverage windows, this Prius Prime is STILL COVERED under Toyota's factory warranty umbrella, giving the next owner real, meaningful protection right out of the gate. 3-Year/36,000-Mile Basic New Vehicle Limited Warranty (roughly a year and over 7,000 miles remaining) 5-Year/60,000-Mile Powertrain Warranty 10-Year/150,000-Mile Hybrid/Plug-in Hybrid Battery Warranty, which transfers to subsequent owners and still has approximately eight years and over 120,000 miles remaining Ask our sales team about extended service plan options to add even more protection on top of this already-strong remaining coverage. Standard Features Every Prius Prime, including this SE grade, comes standard with Toyota Safety Sense 3.0, an 8-inch touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, LED headlights and taillights, and 17-inch alloy wheels, giving buyers a genuinely well-equipped starting point rather than a stripped-down base model. Toyota's latest infotainment architecture and driver-assistance suite come built in from the very first trim level, a real departure from segment norms where these features are often reserved for pricier trims. Exterior Features Midnight Black Metallic gives this Prius Prime a sleek, low-key presence that suits the fifth generation's dramatically lower, wider, and more coupe-like silhouette compared to the model it replaced. LED lighting front and rear sharpens the car's face and improves nighttime visibility, and factory-applied body side moldings add a layer of protection against everyday door dings and parking-lot mishaps. Interior Features Inside, the cabin reflects the same driver-focused redesign as the exterior, with a clean dashboard layout, supportive cloth seating, and materials that feel a genuine step above the outgoing generation. The lower seating position and improved outward visibility make this Prius Prime feel more like a genuine driver's car than any Prius before it, without giving up the practicality of a proper hatchback cargo area. Infotainment & Technology An 8-inch touchscreen puts navigation, audio, and vehicle information within easy reach, with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto letting owners skip the cable entirely. This vehicle also comes factory-equipped with extended Toyota Connected Services coverage, giving the next owner continued access to Drive Connect's cloud-based navigation and Remote Connect's smartphone app features, including remote start, remote lock, and vehicle status monitoring. Subscription may be required to maintain service. Charging, Range & Electrified Powertrain This Prius Prime's 14-kWh battery delivers up to 44 miles of EPA-estimated all-electric range on the SE grade, enough for most owners to handle their entire daily commute without the gas engine ever needing to switch on. Charging is straightforward: a full charge takes approximately 4 hours on a Level 2 home charging station, or roughly 11 hours from a standard 120-volt household outlet overnight. This Prius Prime does not support DC fast charging, so owners should plan around Level 1 or Level 2 charging at home rather than public fast-charging stations, though the gas engine means a fast charger is never actually a necessity for longer trips. Mechanical Features Power comes from a 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with Toyota's hybrid electric motor and an electronically controlled continuously variable transmission, delivering a combined 220 system horsepower and an EPA-estimated 127 MPGe -- a genuine jump in both performance and efficiency over the outgoing Prius Prime. Front-wheel drive keeps the driveline simple and efficient, and the responsive electric motor gives this Prius Prime noticeably quicker off-the-line acceleration than its reputation might suggest. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line This is a Prius Prime that backs up its MotorTrend and North American Car of the Year honors with real substance: genuine daily electric range, a documented one-owner, off-lease history with regular service, and years of factory coverage still ahead of it. For a shopper who wants plug-in flexibility without range anxiety, wrapped in a design that finally matches the car's engineering, this one is hard to beat. Unplug it, plug it in, or forget to plug it in entirely -- this Prius Prime is one of the few cars on the road that genuinely doesn't mind either way. We will happily evaluate your TRADE-IN and offer EXCELLENT FINANCE OPTIONS as well, so please give us a call at 732-919-0707 (Wall Township) or 856-881-2869 (Sewell) TODAY!

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

Turning heads with its sculpted, premium-feeling exterior and a cabin that punches well above its price point, this 2019 Mazda3 5-Door delivers the kind of upscale driving experience shoppers usually have to pay far more to get. Finished in a striking Snowflake White Pearl Mica exterior, this hatchback pairs everyday practicality with genuine driving enjoyment -- a combination that's harder to find than it should be in this class. Thoughtful ergonomics and a commanding driving position round out a cabin that consistently earns praise for feeling more expensive than its price tag suggests. The system is controlled through Mazda's intuitive rotary commander dial, allowing for easy adjustments without taking eyes off the road. Discover the 2025 Honda Civic Hatchback Sport, a stylish and versatile used vehicle that combines sporty performance with modern technology. With just over 30,000 miles, this Crystal Black Pearl hatchback offers a sleek exterior complemented by a refined black interior. Powered by a 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine producing 150 horsepower at 6,400 rpm and 133 lb-ft of torque at 4,000 rpm, it delivers a spirited yet fuel-efficient drive with 30 mpg in the city and 38 mpg on the highway. Its automatic transmission and front-wheel-drive system ensure smooth handling and ease of driving, perfect for daily commutes or weekend adventures. The sporty hatchback design provides five spacious seats and four doors, making it practical for families or those who need flexibility without sacrificing style.

This Honda Civic Hatchback Sport packs a host of advanced features designed to enhance comfort, safety, and connectivity. Adaptive cruise control makes highway driving stress-free, while Apple CarPlay and Bluetooth keep you connected seamlessly. Safety is a priority with a backup camera, blind spot monitor, collision warning, and cross traffic alert, complemented by keyless entry, lane keep assist, and push start for convenience. The interior boasts an infotainment system with a 7-inch touchscreen, voice-operated radio and hands-free calling, and an 8-speaker sound system that fills the cabin with rich audio. Additional features include electronic messaging assistance with read function and compatibility with HondaLink, ensuring you stay connected and entertained on every journey.

2025 Honda Civic Hatchback Safety and Security Features

This vehicle offers comprehensive safety features including a rear seat reminder to alert you of rear passengers, dual knee airbags for added protection, traffic sign recognition to assist with navigation, and four-wheel ABS for optimal stopping power. Power door locks include anti-lockout and auto-locking functions, providing security and convenience. Cornering brake control enhances stability during turns, and an electronic parking brake with auto-off ensures easy parking and safety in various conditions.

2025 Honda Civic Hatchback Entertainment and Technology Features

Entertainment and connectivity are well-covered with HondaLink compatibility for smart device app integration, allowing you to control many functions remotely. The system supports hands-free phone calls and voice-operated radio, making it easy to stay connected safely. The cabin features eight total speakers and a 7-inch touchscreen infotainment display with a touch screen radio interface. Additional features include auxiliary audio input via USB, internet radio through iHeartRadio, and electronic messaging assistance with a read function, providing a versatile and enjoyable driving experience.

2025 Honda Civic Hatchback Performance Features

The Civic Hatchback Sport includes auto start/stop technology, which helps improve fuel efficiency by automatically shutting down and restarting the engine during stops, reducing emissions and saving fuel. This feature adds to the overall efficiency and eco-friendliness of the vehicle, making it a smart choice for drivers looking to balance performance with economy.

Well, butter my biscuit... this ain’t your granddaddy’s Cadillac.

This 2022 Cadillac CT5 V-Series is what happens when Southern sophistication gets a wild streak. Finished in a handsome gray and sitting at approximately 39,436 miles, it packs a 3.0L V6 paired with a smooth 10-speed automatic transmission.

In other words, it'll behave itself when company comes over, but it still knows how to cut loose when nobody's watching.

And mercy, would you look at the equipment:

19" Diamond Cut Aluminum Alloy Wheels with Android Satin Finish
❤️ Red Front & Rear Performance Calipers because apparently subtlety wasn't invited
Platinum & Premium Packages
Bose Performance Series 15-Speaker Premium Audio with SiriusXM 360L
Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Integration
Head-Up Display & Surround Vision Camera System
❄️ Heated & Ventilated Performance Front Bucket Seats
Adaptive Suspension with Four-Wheel Independent Setup
️ Automatic Parking Assist with Braking & Rear Pedestrian Alert
☀️ UltraView Dual Pane Sunroof

Step inside and it's pure Cadillac. You've got a leather-wrapped steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, memory seating, premium comfort, and enough technology to make you feel like you've got your life completely together.

Even if your check-engine light at home says otherwise.

Those heated and ventilated performance seats are especially important around Augusta. Because down here, you might need the heat when you leave for work and the ventilation before lunch. Georgia weather does whatever it wants, bless its heart.

And then there's the Performance Data and Video Recorder capability.

Because telling your buddies how good your Cadillac drives is one thing.

Having receipts is another.

The adaptive suspension helps bring the performance together while this V-Series still delivers the comfort and refinement you'd expect from a Cadillac.

So yes, you can pull up to Sunday dinner looking respectable.

But those red brake calipers are going to tell everybody you've still got a little mischief left in you.

Come see this 2022 Cadillac CT5 V-Series at Jim Hudson Cadillac of Augusta and take it for a drive.

Just don't come drive it unless you're prepared to fall in love with it.

Because once you've got the sunroof open, that Bose system playing, the A/C blowing through those ventilated seats, and that V6 under your right foot...

Well, sugar, that's between you, your wallet, and the good Lord above.
